pages.text: The frame is the base of every drone. Its $(l)tier$() decides how big the battery is, how fast the drone flies, how many $(l:drone_systems/modules)function modules$(/l) it carries and how many $(l:drone_systems/addons)addons$(/l) fit in it.$(br)$(li)$(item)Basic Drone Frame$()$(br)$(li)$(item)Advanced Drone Frame$()$(br)$(li)$(item)Elite Drone Frame$()

$(li)$(l)Basic Drone Frame$(): 1, 40,000 FE, 80% (2.4 blocks/s), 1, 4, 4 FE/t$(br)$(li)$(l)Advanced Drone Frame$(): 2, 120,000 FE, 130% (3.9 blocks/s), 2, 8, 6 FE/t$(br)$(li)$(l)Elite Drone Frame$(): 3, 300,000 FE, 160% (4.8 blocks/s), 3, 16, 8 FE/t
pages.title: Comparing the frames

pages.text: $(li)$(l)Speed$(): each Speed Addon adds 10% on top of the frame speed. Above 100%, the same speed also shortens the work itself: digging, clearing a site, cutting trees, soaking up fluid and waiting for a catch. Guard and Bomb drones fire and dive at their own pace.
$(li)$(l)Flight cost$(): the frame's share of the drone's $(l:drone_systems/drones)power use$(/l).

pages.title: The Mini Drone Frame
pages.text: A drone built on the Mini Drone Frame is a $(l)Mini Drone$(): half the size of the others. It is made for two jobs only: it takes the $(l:drone_systems/modules)Builder Module$(/l) or the $(l:drone_systems/modules)Bomb Module$(/l) and nothing else.
A Mini Drone lives only on a $(l:drone_systems/swarm_dock)Builder Swarm Dock$(/l), which takes up to four, each on its own corner of the pad.

The Basic and Mini frames are made of $(l:materials/aluminum)aluminum$(/l). The Advanced and Elite frames are made of $(l:materials/carbon_fiber)carbon fiber$(/l), with $(l:materials/circuits)Advanced and Elite Circuits$(/l).$(br2)Higher tiers are crafted from the tier below, so you never lose your progress.
